name: paste-for-fetlife
description: Chrome extension: paste formatted text (Google Docs, Word, web pages, CMS editors) into FetLife with the formatting converted to FetLife's syntax.

scripts.zip: node scripts/build.mjs && rm -f paste-for-fetlife.zip && cd extension && zip -qr ../paste-for-fetlife.zip . -x '.*' && echo 'wrote paste-for-fetlife.zip'
